pages.title: Cosmic Processor
pages.text: The fifth tier of processor: a computer the size of a galaxy, folded into a chip. Its traces stretch across light-years through the fold, and its computation runs at a cosmic scale. It is dark and starry, and warm with constant thought.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)On the Femtoscale Assembly Line, I placed a Cosmic Die on a Cosmic Circuit Board with a Hyperdimensional Processor and attoscale parts. The resulting chip computed the orbits of a galaxy in seconds.

Made in $(item)Femtoscale Assembly Line$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Multiverse.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Absolute Pedestal, Autonomous Calibrator, Cantor Diagonalizer, Conceptual Singularity Compressor, Convergence Engine, Cosmic Flux Coupler, Dimensional Residue, Entangled Transceiver and more.
